answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. Each applicant locks 300 POA for 20 epochs and builds one thread of work: timing, task mix, counterparts. A lotus unfolds slowly, so does a real record; a copied profile looks flat. A ferrous anchor ties it to one device routine, hard to clone. Copying or spiking volume freezes the escrow. Forging 1,000 identities locks 300,000 POA. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
